title: Voices from the Grave (BBC Radio)
paragraphs: A BBC series of four intimate supernatural dramas inspired by ghost stories from around Britain, using hauntings to explore grief, love, anger, longing, and other human emotions.

Four intimate supernatural dramas inspired by British ghost stories/legends. Frozen GRH files carry a March 7-10, 2006 sequence and Radio 4 packaging, while other references describe BBC 7 commissioning and conflicting first-broadcast order/date. Conflict is preserved explicitly.
GRH documents the program through Frozen March 2006 sequence (March 7, 2006 to March 10, 2006) on [[org|org.deepv2.f713a484394d0d32|BBC Radio]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Gemma Jenkins (producer on 3 recordings), Geoffrey Beevers (performer on 2 recordings), Luke Fresle (producer on 2 recordings), Christian Patterson (performer on 1 recording), David Varela (writer on 1 recording), Dylan Ritson (writer on 1 recording), and Elizabeth Morgan (performer on 1 recording).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include haunted places and supernatural encounter, grief love rage longing and pain, Victorian London haunted-house tradition, Welsh village curse and folk belief, psychiatric hospital and institutional decay, and faith, missionary return and biblical horror.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Frozen March 2006 Voices from the Grave chronology and Voices from the Grave network/date metadata conflict.
